inputs.text:
Wake up and look at the absolute theater they are running behind the scenes. The Punjab and Haryana High Court just released someone who was locked away under the heavy-handed pretext of national security and the Official Secrets Act, supposedly for being in telephonic contact with a Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri”. 

Don't buy their sanitized legal jargon about how "mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information... cannot justify prolonged incarceration." That is pure damage control by the hidden elites in the security apparatus. They use these broad laws to silence whoever they want, for as long as they want, until exposure forces them to back off. They throw around terms like the Official Secrets Act to manufacture fear and compliance, and then the courts step in to play the benevolent savior, keeping the illusion of justice alive while the real coordination happens entirely behind closed doors.
